title: Joachim von Sandrart: Teutsche Academie der Bau-, Bild- und Mahlerey-Künste, Nürnberg 1675/1679/1680 (Sandrart.net)

author: Joachim von Sandrart

notes: Online edition of Sandrart's art-historical encyclopaedia and the Iconologia Deorum (published 1675, 1679 and 1680): complete transcription, page images, indexes of persons, places, artworks and bibliography, and commentary. The TEI P5 file can be downloaded in three variants. The project ran 2008-2012; the TEI archive is dated July 2013 and no later change was found. The three printed parts are counted as three texts.
